adds.title: Governor Rui Costa decree on social name (May 23, 2017)
adds.summary: On May 23, 2017 Governor Rui Costa decreed that travesti and transexual persons have the right to use their social name and have their gender identity recognized in all organs and entities of Bahia's state direct and indirect public administration.

adds.title: Salvador municipal law banning teaching of gender identity in schools
adds.summary: Salvador municipal law prohibits gender-identity material in schools in Salvador.
